name: GKN Simba
origin: United Kingdom (GKN), assembled in the Philippines
armament: 12.7 mm or 7.62 mm in a one-man turret (Simba IFV: 25 mm)
protection: Game: immune to small-calibre rounds (5.45/5.56/5.8/7.62x39/7.62x51 ball); 7.62x54R and larger penetrate side/rear and disable tyres and engine; any launcher destroys it.
visual_notes: Boxy 4x4 with flat sloped front and large wheels
Small turret on the roof, side and rear doors
Workhorse of Philippine counter-insurgency in Mindanao
